carl-jung-s-break-with-freud-the-feud-th.description: In 1907, Sigmund Freud and Carl Jung began a partnership that redefined modern psychology. In this episode, we explore the historic rift between Freud and Jung, the reality of the Collective Unconscious, and why integrating your rejected Shadow is the ultimate prerequisite for reclaiming sovereign power in an externalized world.
